# Run budgets

Open **Settings → Budgets** to set account defaults for each new run. Leave a
limit blank for unlimited usage, or enter a token limit, an estimated USD limit,
or both. Zero pauses a run before its first model request.

A run's allowance covers its main agent, delegates, and retries. OE reserves
enough allowance for a request before sending it and reconciles the reservation
with reported usage afterwards. Other simultaneous requests count against the
remaining allowance. Existing accounts stay unlimited until you configure limits.

When a project is selected, the same screen offers a cumulative project limit
and an optional default for each new project run. Usage from runs in that project
counts toward the project total. Account defaults apply when the project has no
per-run override.

Project totals begin with budget tracking; older activity is not imported
retroactively.

## Estimate a task

Choose an agent, enter a task, and select **Estimate first request**. This estimates
one request and its output allowance. Chat history, runtime context, subsequent
requests and delegates can add usage, so it is not a total-workflow quote.

USD figures use OE's available pricing data and are estimates. Provider billing,
images, hosted tools and other services may differ. When pricing is unknown, use
a token-only limit. Endpoints that cannot enforce an output cap pause under
configured limits rather than making an unbounded request.

## Continue paused work

A run pauses before a request that would exceed its run or project allowance.
Open it from **Needs attention** or the recent-run list in **Budgets**. Review its
usage, select the paused work, and enter additional allowance. Project limits may
also need an increase. **Authorize and continue selected work** is an explicit
decision; changing defaults alone does not resume a paused task.

Unknown provider usage retains its reservation until you explicitly accept the
full reserved estimate. Interrupted actions that could change something require
review of their outcome before continuation. OE keeps completed action receipts
so the continuation can use their results.

If you stopped a request before its usage was reported, **Account for reserved
estimate** settles that reservation without restarting the cancelled work.

Pauses and usage survive a server restart. Continued work runs as a tracked job
with progress and Stop controls. A cleared chat, removed agent, or changed access
can prevent continuation; start a new task after reviewing the saved result in
that case.

Some team, multi-stage, or scheduled jobs already disable automatic recovery.
Those jobs still require manual review and a new task using their saved results;
increasing the allowance does not bypass their recovery restrictions.
